name: Matet (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a yellow four-petalled flower.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 20 January 2006 of the conseller de Justícia, Interior i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, red, with a four-petalled flower of or at the centre, from the traditional arms of the village (approved 26 June 2000).
